category.label: Slurry, manure, and agricultural effluent management
category.description: UK legal controls on the storage, handling, spreading, land application, disposal, and pollution prevention of livestock slurry, manure, farmyard manure, poultry manure, pig slurry, liquid manure, silage effluent, agricultural effluent, farm effluent, digestate, and other livestock waste. Core sources include instruments that directly regulate slurry or manure storage infrastructure, silage effluent, agricultural pollution, nitrate vulnerable zones, nutrient action programmes, agricultural diffuse pollution, organic manure application, closed periods, application rates, buffer zones, runoff prevention, and ammonia or water pollution from livestock waste. Treat generic engineering or environmental terms such as freeboard, structural integrity, secondary containment, controlled waters, groundwater protection, buffer zones, and water pollution as supporting signals only: they are not enough on their own unless clearly connected to agricultural slurry, manure, livestock waste, silage effluent, agricultural pollution, or nitrate controls.
synonyms: silage slurry and agricultural fuel oil
exclusions: public roads, traffic, railway, tramway, harbour, gas, water authority or local improvement acts unless they clearly regulate agricultural slurry or manure
plant health or crop disease controls unless they directly regulate manure or slurry spreading as livestock waste management
animal disease controls unless they directly regulate disposal or handling of slurry, manure, or livestock waste
non-UK EU nitrate derogation decisions for Belgium, Denmark, Italy, Netherlands, Germany, Austria, or other non-UK member states
municipal recycling, composting, sewerage or waste targets unless clearly about agricultural livestock waste or farm digestate
